blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Urban spatial intelligence calls for 3D cities that agents can measure, interpret, and modify across successive tasks. Maintaining such cities as persistent, code-based states requires lightweight acquisition and support for consistent state updates without repeated dense reconstruction. We therefore formulate a new setting for grounded urban world construction: generating large-scale, instance-level parameterized 3D cities from one low-altitude aerial RGB image per region and known camera parameters, while recovering metrically scaled buildings and explicit road geometry and connectivity. We introduce CityCode, an agent-operable representation that unifies metric geometry, urban topology, visual semantics, and 3D assets through persistent entity identities, with dependency-aware versioned execution for validated updates and historical restoration. We further develop Air2Code to construct this representation by combining visual structure extraction with adapted metric depth estimation. To address occlusion and incomplete coverage, recovered structure and observed appearance guide generative completion and subsequent structure-aware 3D generation for buildings and backgrounds. Experiments on CitySample-Aerial and UrbanScene3D demonstrate substantially more accurate metric structure recovery and superior visual fidelity to the target cities compared with the evaluated baselines. Across 50 task chains of 50 steps each, CityCode supports continued querying, editing, planning, and historical restoration over evolving city states. Together, CityCode and Air2Code turn sparse aerial observations into persistent, agent-operable urban worlds for long-horizon urban spatial intelligence.
blocks.zh: 城市空间情报需要3D城市,使代理人能够测量、解释和修改连续的任务。 维持持续,以代码为基础的状态等城市,需要轻量级的获取和支持一致的状态更新而不重复密集重建. 因此,我们为基于城市的世界建设制定一个新的环境:从每个区域一个低空空中RGB图像和已知相机参数生成大规模、实例级参数化的三维城市,同时恢复测量规模的建筑物和明确的道路几何和连通性。 我们引入了CityCode(City Code),这是一个可操作的代理代表,它通过持续的实体身份来统一度量几何,城市地貌,视觉语义和3D资产,并具有依赖意识版本的执行,用于验证更新和历史修复. 我们进一步发展了Air2Code,通过将视觉结构提取与调整后的测量深度估计相结合来构建这种表示. 为解决隔离和覆盖不完整的问题,恢复结构和观察外观指导建筑物和背景的分基因完成和随后的结构意识3D生成。 关于CitySample-Air和UrbanScene3D的实验表明,与所评估的基线相比,对目标城市的测量结构恢复和较高的视觉忠诚度要高得多。 在50个任务链中,每个50个步骤,CityCode支持持续查询、编辑、规划和历史修复,以覆盖不断演变的城市州。 CityCode和Air2Code一起,将稀有的空中观测变成能持续使用剂的城市世界,用于长相空间智能.

CityCode unifies metric building instances, road and block topology, and generated appearance through persistent entity identities. The highlighted building links visual evidence, a geometric proxy, and a 3D asset. The sequence illustrates extension, editing, retrieval, and planning over a shared city state. See the supplementary video for city generation results and long-horizon spatial interaction.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Urban spatial intelligence calls for agents that can understand and act on 3D environments across successive tasks.
For a specific city, this includes locating buildings, measuring their geometry, reasoning about road access, and modifying layouts, etc.
These operations require connecting the city’s metric geometry, road connectivity, and visual semantics, etc. ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Caldarelli et al., 2023 ) .
As edits accumulate, subsequent queries and plans must remain consistent with the updated entities and spatial relationships.
These needs motivate constructing agent-operable 3D cities: structured environments built from observations of a target city and maintained across tasks for continued spatial reasoning and action.
blocks.zh:
城市空间情报需要能够理解并针对3D环境采取行动的代理商,这些代理商贯穿连续的任务.
对于特定的城市,这包括定位建筑物,测量其几何,关于道路通行的推理,以及修改布局等.
这些操作需要连接城市的度量几何,道路连接,以及视觉语义等. (张等,2026年;卡尔达雷利等,2023年).
随着编辑的积累,随后的查询和计划必须与更新的实体和空间关系保持一致.
这些需要激励着建设可使用代理人的三维城市:从目标城市的观测中构建的结构化环境,并维持在各项任务之间,以便继续进行空间推理和行动。

blocks.en:
A key challenge is constructing such worlds from limited input.
Design-driven approaches, including CityGenAgent, CityCraft, and MajutsuCity, generate programs, layouts, and assets from user requirements ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) .
Other methods, including the UrbanWorld series and layout-conditioned generative models, use maps, building geometry, semantic layouts, or height information to guide construction ( Shang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025c ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Chung et al., 2026 ) .
These inputs provide structural control, but synthesized layouts need not correspond to a target city, while maps may have incomplete coverage, missing heights, or outdated geometry ( Herfort et al., 2023 ; Bernard et al., 2022 ; Juhász, 2021 ) .
Sparse aerial observations offer a lightweight and timely source of visual evidence about a target city ( Remondino et al., 2011 ) , allowing its structure to be recovered for generation and spatial operations.
blocks.zh:
一项关键挑战是利用有限的投入来建设这样的世界。
设计驱动方式,包括CityGenAgent,CityCraft,和MajutsuCity,从用户需求中生成程序,布局和资产(Liu等人,2026年;Deng等人,2024年;Huang等人,2025年).
其他方法,包括"城市世界"系列和布局有条件的基因模型,使用地图,构建几何,语义布局,或高度信息来指导建设(Sang等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025b;Wang等人,2025c;Xie等人,2025年;Chung等人,2026年).
这些输入提供了结构控制,但合成布局不需要对应目标城市,而地图可能覆盖不完整,高度缺失,或几何学过时(Herfort等人,2023年;Bernard等人,2022年;Juhász,2021年).
Sparse航空观测为目标城市提供了轻量级和及时的视觉证据来源(Remondino等人,2011年),使其结构得以恢复,用于生成和空间操作.

blocks.en:
Image-conditioned methods such as Sat2City v2, Sat2Density++, Sat3DGen, MagicCity, and SceneFuse-3D generate or reconstruct urban scenes from aerial or satellite imagery ( Hua et al., 2026 ; Qian et al., 2026a ; Qian et al., 2026b ; Yao et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) .
Their primary focus is scene-level synthesis or reconstruction, rather than jointly recovering metrically parameterized building instances, explicit road connectivity, and entity-linked assets for subsequent spatial operations.
Sparse aerial views leave substantial facade appearance and occluded geometry unobserved.
Constructing a usable city from these views requires coordinating structure recovery with generative completion: synthesized details must remain compatible with recovered massing, location, and metric scale.
blocks.zh:
诸如Sat2City v2, Sat2Density++, Sat3DGen, MagicCity, 和SceneFuse-3D 等具有图像条件的方法从空中或卫星图像中生成或重建城市场景(Hua等人,2026年;Qian等人,2026年a; Q等人,2026b;姚等人,2025;郑等人,2025).
其主要重点是场景层面的合成或重建,而不是共同恢复以参数表示的建筑实例、明确的道路连接以及随后的空间操作中与实体相关的资产。
平坦的空中视野留下了巨大的外观,并且没有观测到几何形状。
从这些观点构建一个可用的城市需要协调结构恢复和基因完成:综合细节必须与恢复的质地、位置和尺度保持兼容。

blocks.en:
We introduce a new setting for grounded urban world construction: generating instance-level parameterized 3D cities from sparse aerial observations for continued spatial reasoning and action.
Given one low-altitude aerial RGB image per region and known camera parameters, the goal is to jointly construct measurable building geometry, explicit road connectivity, and detailed appearance (Figure 1 ).
Our central idea is to use recovered metric entities as a common interface between observations, generated assets, and spatial operations.
Each building retains one identity linking its visual evidence, metric structure, and generated asset across construction and subsequent tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们为立足的城市世界建设引入了一个新的环境:从稀少的空中观测中产生实例级的三维参数城市,以便继续进行空间推理和行动。
鉴于每个区域有一个低空空中RGB图像和已知的相机参数,目标是共同构建可测量的建筑几何、明确的道路连接和详细的外观(图1)。
我们的中心思想是利用回收的计量实体作为观测、生成的资产和空间操作之间的共同接口。
每栋建筑都保留一个特征,将视觉证据、计量结构以及整个建筑和后续任务产生的资产联系起来。

blocks.en:
To realize this idea, we introduce CityCode, an agent-operable representation linking metric urban structure, observation evidence, visual semantics, and 3D assets through persistent entity identities.
Air2Code constructs this representation by combining visual structure extraction with adapted metric depth estimation (Figure 2 ).
Its structure-and-observation-guided generation completes geometry and appearance from sparse observations, combining appearance completion and structure-aware 3D generation for buildings with height-guided background generation.
During subsequent interaction, CityCode’s dependency-aware versioned execution validates supported edits, updates affected records, and enables queries, planning, and historical restoration.
blocks.zh:
为了实现这个想法,我们引入了CityCode, 一种可操作的代理代表, 通过持续的实体身份连接了 公制城市结构,观测证据,视觉语义, 和3D资产。
Air2Code通过将视觉结构提取与经调整的测量深度估计相结合来构建这种表示(图2 )。
其结构-观测-制导生成完成几何学和从稀少的观测中外观,结合了外观完成和结构-感知3D生成,用于建筑与高导背景生成.
在随后的互动中,CityCode的依赖意识版本执行验证支持编辑,更新受影响的记录,并允许查询,规划和历史修复.

blocks.en:
Experiments on synthetic and real-world-derived scenes demonstrate improved metric geometry and leading visual quality on CitySample-Aerial (CS-Aerial) and UrbanScene3D among the evaluated baselines.
Ablations examine the contributions of depth adaptation, scale calibration, and structural guidance in generation.
We further evaluate continued city-state use across 50 task chains of 50 steps each, covering construction, editing, querying, planning, and historical restoration.
All 2,500 steps pass their task checks under the documented execution protocol, with operations continuing after restoration.
Together, CityCode and Air2Code construct grounded urban worlds with accurate metric geometry and leading visual quality, providing persistent, agent-operable environments for long-horizon urban spatial intelligence.
blocks.zh:
关于合成场景和真实世界衍生场景的实验表明,在评估的基线中,CitySample-Air(CS-Air)和UrbanScene3D的度量几何学和主要视觉质量得到改善。
校准审查深度适应、尺度校准和结构指导对生成的贡献。
我们进一步评价50个任务链持续使用城市国家,每个任务链50个步骤,包括建筑、编辑、查询、规划和历史修复。
所有2 500个步骤都根据有文件证明的执行协议通过了任务检查,恢复后继续开展行动。
CityCode和Air2Code共同构建了具有精确度量几何学和领先视觉质量的基底城市世界,为长视距城市空间智能提供了持久、可使用剂的环境。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Urban Modeling and Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 城市建模和生成

blocks.en:
Design-driven and structure-conditioned generation. CityGenAgent, CityCraft, and MajutsuCity synthesize programs, layouts, and assets from design specifications, supporting structured control and editing ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) .
CityX and UrbanWorld support map-conditioned construction; UrbanWorld2.0 adds street-view evidence for reality-aligned assets ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Shang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) .
CityDreamer, GaussianCity, and CityDreamer4D use layouts and heights; CityDreamer4D supports dynamic traffic and navigation ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) .
Sat2RealCity combines satellite appearance with building footprints and heights ( Wang et al., 2025c ) . Sat2City and Map2World use height and segment maps, respectively ( Hua et al., 2025 ; Chung et al., 2026 ) .
Structural conditions are synthesized or supplied.
blocks.zh:
设计驱动和结构条件发电. CityGenAgent、CityCraft和MajutsuCity从设计规格中合成程序、布局和资产,支持结构化控制和编辑(Liu等人,2026年;Deng等人,2024年;Huang等人,2025年)。
CityX 和 UrbanWorld 支持地图有条件的建设; UrbanWorld2.0 添加了符合现实资产的街景证据(Zhang等人,2024年;Sang等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025年b).
城市梦客,高斯城和城市梦客4 D使用布局和高度;CityDreamer4D支持动态交通和导航(谢等人,2024年;谢等人,2025年;谢等人,2026年).
Sat2 真实 城市将卫星外观与建筑脚印和高度相结合(Wang等人,2025c.). Sat2City和Map2World分别使用高度图和段图(Hua等人,2025年;Chung等人,2026年).
结构条件被合成或提供.

blocks.en:
Image-conditioned 3D scene generation. Sat2City v2 generates textured 3D city assets from satellite imagery ( Hua et al., 2026 ) .
Sat2Density++ learns radiance fields for satellite-to-street-view synthesis, while Sat3DGen generates street-level scenes with mesh extraction ( Qian et al., 2026a ; Qian et al., 2026b ) .
MagicCity reconstructs Gaussian scenes from generated views with instance-consistency guidance ( Yao et al., 2025 ) . SceneFuse-3D combines regional generation and 3D inpainting from a single top-down image ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) .
These methods emphasize scene-level generation; Air2Code constructs metric building instances, explicit road connectivity, and associated 3D assets from sparse observations.
blocks.zh:
图像有条件的3D场景生成. Sat2City v2从卫星图像中生成纹理3D城市资产(Hua等人,2026年).
Sat2Density++ 学习用于卫星对街景合成的辐射场,而Sat3DGen 则用网格提取生成街道级场景(Qian等人,2026a; Q等, 2026b ).
魔术城重建 高斯的场景来自以实例一致性指导产生的观点(姚等人,2025年). SceneFuse-3D结合了区域生成和从一个单一的自上而下图像的3D涂装(郑等人,2025年).
这些方法强调场景层生成; Air2Code构建了公制建筑实例,明确的道路连通性,以及从稀少的观测中获取的相关3D资产.

blocks.en: 2.2 Structured Representations and Spatial Interaction
blocks.zh: 2.2 结构化的代表和空间互动

blocks.en:
CityGML 3.0 defines semantic urban objects and model versions ( Open Geospatial Consortium, 2021 ) .
SpatialLM recovers indoor layouts and objects from point clouds ( Mao et al., 2025 ) . Hydra and ConceptGraphs build 3D scene graphs ( Hughes et al., 2022 ; Gu et al., 2023 ) .
SayPlan uses hierarchical scene graphs and feedback for planning ( Rana et al., 2023 ) . LEO integrates 3D perception, grounding, reasoning, and action ( Huang et al., 2024 ) .
CityBench evaluates urban understanding and decision-making ( Feng et al., 2025 ) . CityCube studies cross-view spatial reasoning ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . MetaUrban provides urban environments for embodied navigation ( Wu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
城市GML( 城市GML) 3.0定义了语义性城市物体和模型版本(Open Gracial Consortium, 2021.).
空间 LM从点云恢复室内布局和物体(Mao等人,2025年). Hydra和ConceptGraphs构建3D场景图(Hughes等人,2022年;Gu等人,2023年).
SayPlan使用分级场景图和反馈进行规划(Rana等人,2023年). LEO融合了3D感知,定位,推理,以及动作(Huang等人,2024年).
City Bench评价城市理解与决策(冯等人,2025年). CityCube研究跨视空间推理(徐等人,2026年). MetaUrban为体现的导航提供了城市环境(Wu等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
Code World Model separates code-maintained state evolution from proxy-conditioned visual generation ( Chen et al., 2026 ) .
SceneCode links indoor-world programs and simulation assets through a persistent registry for local editing ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Recursive Code World Models reconstruct image-conditioned 3D worlds through recursive scene programs ( Li et al., 2026b ) .
CityCode links metric building instances, road connectivity, and assets to observations and supports version-bound queries and plans after dependent edits and historical restoration.
blocks.zh:
Code World Model将代码维护状态演化与代用条件视觉生成分离(Chen等人,2026年).
SceneCode通过一个持续的本地编辑登记册将室内-世界程序和模拟资产联系起来(Wang等人,2026年)。 递归码世界模型通过递归场景程序重建图像条件的3D世界(Li等人,2026b ).
CityCode将公制建筑实例,道路连通性,资产与观测联系起来,并在依赖编辑和历史修复后支持有版本的查询和计划.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of CityCode and Air2Code. Air2Code recovers metric urban structure from regional aerial observations and uses recovered geometry and visual evidence to guide building and background generation. CityCode links structure, evidence, assets, and visual-semantic embeddings through persistent entity identities in a shared, versioned city state.
blocks.zh: 图2:城市代码和Air2Code概览. Air2Code从区域航空观测中恢复了测量的城市结构,并使用回收的几何学和视觉证据来指导建筑和背景生成. CityCode通过持续实体身份将结构,证据,资产和视觉语义嵌入在一个共享的,版本化的城市状态中.

blocks.en: 3.1 CityCode Representation
blocks.zh: 3.1 城市代码代表制

blocks.en: CityCode organizes buildings, roads, blocks, and environment layers in a shared metric frame (Figure 1 ). Building footprints, base elevations, and heights define LoD1 proxies. Roads form a spatial graph with centerlines, widths, and connectivity; blocks and spatial relations encode building membership, neighborhoods, and road associations. Environment layers provide registered background imagery and available height and confidence fields. Structural projections to OSM XML and CityJSON support map and semantic 3D interchange (Appendix ).
blocks.zh: CityCode将建筑物,道路,街区,以及环境层组织在一个共享的度量框架(图1)中. 建筑脚印,基座高,和高度定义了LOD1代位. 道路构成一个空间图,有中心线、宽度和连通性;区块和空间关系编码建设成员、邻里和道路协会。 环境层提供了已注册的背景图像以及可用的高度和置信场. 结构预测到OSM XML和CityJSON支持地图和语义3D交换(Appendix ).

blocks.en: An immutable city revision stores entities, the road graph, blocks, spatial relations, environment layers, and asset bindings. Entity lookup and derived appearance indexes are revision-bound. Unchanged evidence and assets are shared across revisions. Section 3.3 describes updates, validation, and restoration.
blocks.zh: 不可改变的城市修订存储实体,道路图,区块,空间关系,环境层,资产约束. 实体查询和衍生的外观指数受修订约束。 未经更改的证据和资产在各项修订中共享。 第3.3节描述了更新、验证和恢复。

blocks.en: 3.2 Air2Code: Construction from Sparse Aerial Observations
blocks.zh: 3.2 Air2Code:从Sparse空中观测建造

blocks.en: Air2Code constructs the CityCode representation from one aerial RGB image I I per region, camera intrinsics K K , and camera-to-world pose ( R , t ) (R,t) .
blocks.zh: Air2Code从每个区域一个空中的RGB图像I, 摄像头内在的K K, 以及相机对世界的姿势(R, t) (R, t), 构建了CityCode代表.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Metric Urban Structure Recovery
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 城市结构恢复

blocks.en: Gemini 3 Pro Image extracts building-instance and background-semantic masks. Road and hardscape pixels in the latter provide ground anchors for scale calibration. We fine-tune MoGe2-Aerial ( Song et al., 2026 ) on rendered BigCity RGB–depth pairs from CS-Aerial using an affine-invariant point-map loss and metric-scale supervision, yielding camera-forward depth d ^ \hat{d} and recovering a metrically scaled scene before ground calibration.

blocks.en: 3.3 Dependency-Aware Versioned Execution
blocks.zh: 3.3 依赖- 了解版本的执行

blocks.en: CityCode supports tool-mediated interaction ( Yao et al., 2023 ) over an evolving city by coupling revision-bound queries with dependency-aware, validated edits (Figure 4 ). Operation schemas, dependency rules, and recovery are detailed in Appendix .
blocks.zh: CityCode 支持工具调解互动 (Yao等人,2023年)通过将修订后输入的查询与依赖意识结合,验证编辑(图4),覆盖一个不断发展的城市. 附录详细介绍了业务计划、依赖规则和恢复情况。

blocks.en: Each request specifies an operation, arguments, and a read revision. Queries leave that snapshot unchanged: measurements use its entity geometry, routing its road graph, and visibility its transformed meshes. Edits must reference the current revision. Stale requests are rejected with feedback for replanning. Results remain linked to the revision they read.
blocks.zh: 每个请求都指定了操作、参数和读取的修改。 查询没有改变:测量使用其实体几何、路由图和能见度。 编辑必须参考当前修订版。 Stale 请求被拒绝,但有反馈要求重新规划。 结果仍然与他们读到的修订有关。

blocks.en: An edit produces a candidate updated through operation-specific dependency rules. Building edits synchronize geometry, asset transforms, block membership, and spatial relations; road edits update the graph, blocks, affected building associations, and background layers. Applicable checks on geometry, road clearance, and preservation of unselected entities precede publication. If checks fail, validation feedback guides the caller in revising the candidate. Appearance-index maintenance follows publication: geometric queries remain available, while semantic queries requiring that index are withheld until it is ready and matches the published revision.
blocks.zh: 编辑后产生通过特定操作依赖规则更新的候选人. 建筑编辑同步几何,资产转换,块成员,和空间关系;道路编辑更新图表,块,受影响的建筑协会,以及背景层. 在公布前对几何、道路清理和未选定实体的保存进行相关检查。 如果检查失败,验证反馈指导呼叫者修改候选人. 外观-索引维护在发布后进行:仍然有几何查询,而要求索引的语义查询则在准备就绪并符合已公布的修订版之前不予提供。

blocks.en: Accepted edits publish immutable snapshots with receipts linking requests to their read and resulting revisions. Request identifiers prevent duplicate commits on retry. Historical queries inspect earlier snapshots; restoration verifies referenced resources and publishes the selected historical state as a new revision, preserving intervening history. Queries, edits, and plans can continue from the restored state.
blocks.zh: 接受编辑者公布不可改变的快照,收据将请求与阅读和随后的修订联系起来。 请求的标识符防止重复重复重试。 历史查询检查了早期的快照;修复验证了引用的资源,并将选定的历史状态作为新的修订出版,保留干预历史. 查询,编辑,计划可以从恢复状态继续.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We construct CS-Aerial from the Unreal Engine City Sample project ( Epic Games, 2022 ) , comprising rendered aerial RGB images, camera intrinsics and poses, and simplified 3D urban layout annotations. BigCity provides rendered RGB–depth pairs for adaptation. A separate map provides evaluation data. Their sampled areas cover approximately 22.58 and 2.79 km 2 , respectively. We also evaluate on the three largest UrbanScene3D scenes by area ( Lin et al., 2022 ) : Qingdao Square, Qingdao Hospital, and Shenzhen University Campus, rendering observations from their reconstructed textured meshes. Reconstruction uses one aerial RGB image per approximately × 400 400\!\times\!400 m patch, at × 2560 2560\!\times\!2560 for CS-Aerial and × 1024 1024\!\times\!1024 for UrbanScene3D. We use eight NVIDIA A100 GPUs. Data preparation and structural extraction details are provided in Appendix .
blocks.zh: 我们从不真实的引擎城市样本项目(Epic Games, 2022)中构建了CS-Air, 包括已成型的空中RGB图像、摄像头内在和姿势, BigCity为适应提供了制作的 RGB – 深度配对. 单独的地图提供评价数据。 它们的采样面积分别约为22.58和2.79 km 2。 我们还按地区评估三个最大的UrbanScene3D场景(Lin等人,2022年): 青岛广场 青岛医院 深圳大学校园 对其重建的文字素描进行观察. 重建使用一个空中RGB图像,每块大约为 × 400 400\ !\ times\ !400 m 补丁,在 × 2560 2560\ !\ times\ !2560 为 CS- Air 和 × 1024 1024\ 1024 为 UrbanScene3D 。 我们使用8个NVIDIA A100 GPU. 数据编制和结构提取细节载于附录。

blocks.en: Our baselines include GaussianCity ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , CityDreamer4D (GoogleEarth) ( Xie et al., 2026 ) , Sat3DGen ( Qian et al., 2026b ) , Sat2Density++ ( Qian et al., 2026a ) , UrbanWorld2.0 ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , and MajutsuCity ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . Visual metrics cover pixel and structural fidelity (PSNR/SSIM), perceptual similarity (LPIPS, AlexNet), and rendered-image distributions (FID/KID). Building metrics include foreground RGB MAE, DINOv2 feature similarity, and footprint and 2.5D prism IoU after similarity alignment. Method-specific inputs, rendering, and evaluation protocols are detailed in Appendix .
blocks.zh: 我们的基线包括高斯城市(谢等人,2025年),城市梦4D(GoogleEarth)(谢等人,2026年),Sat3DGen(Q等人,2026年b),Sat2Density++. (Qian等人,2026a) , UrbanWorld2.0 (Wang等人,2025b), 和 MajutsuCity (Huang等人,2025). 视觉度量包括像素和结构忠诚度(PSNR/SSIM)、感知相似度(LPIPS、AlexNet)和渲染图像分布(FID/KID)。 建筑度量衡包括前缘RGB MAE,DINOv2特征相似,足迹和2.5D棱镜IoU在相似度对齐后. 具体方法的投入、渲染和评价协议详见附录。

blocks.en: 4.2 City and Building Generation Quality
blocks.zh: 4.2 城市和建筑一代质量

blocks.en: CityCode ranks first on all seven CS-Aerial metrics and six of seven UrbanScene3D metrics (Table 1 ). It ranks second on UrbanScene3D SSIM (0.286 vs. 0.290). CS-Aerial PSNR exceeds the strongest baseline by 1.17 dB. Across both datasets and prompts, its VLM preference rates lead the strongest baseline by 10.09–44.74 percentage points. Image metrics use 1,000 CS-Aerial and 217 UrbanScene3D views at × 1024 1024\!\times\!1024 . VLM comparisons use 300 and 217 views, respectively.
blocks.zh: CityCode在所有7个CS-Air度量衡和7个UrbanScene3D度量衡中排名第一(表1)。 它在UrbanScene3D SSIM上排名第二(0.286对0.290). CS-Air PSNR超过最强基线1.17 dB. 在整个数据集和提示中,其VLM偏好率是10.09-44.74个百分点的最强基线。 图像度量衡使用1000 CS-Air和217 UrbanScene3D的视图,分别位于x 1024 1024\times\!1024. VLM比较分别使用300和217的视图.

blocks.en: CityCode more closely matches reference building massing, street layout, and appearance (Figure 3 ), consistent with the quantitative results. Recovered structure and observed appearance jointly ground generative completion in aerial evidence, while structure-aware 3D generation helps preserve building shape and proportions. Although UrbanWorld2.0 and Sat3DGen also use input imagery, their outputs show weaker correspondence to the observed scene, suggesting less effective use of this evidence to constrain generation. Ground regions also show simplified road and vegetation patterns in UrbanWorld2.0 and blurred surface textures in Sat3DGen.
blocks.zh: CityCode更贴近参考建筑群,街道布局,以及外观(图3),与量化结果一致. 恢复结构和观测到的外观在空中证据中共同进行地面遗传性完成,而结构感知的3D生成有助于保存建筑形状和比例. 虽然UrbanWorld2.0和Sat3DGen也使用输入图像,但他们的输出显示与所观测场景的对应力较弱,说明使用这种证据限制生成的效果较差. 地面区域在UrbanWorld2.0中还显示出简化的道路和植被模式,在Sat3DGen中显示出模糊的表面纹理.

blocks.en: Figure 3: City-level qualitative comparison. Top two rows: CS-Aerial; bottom two: Qingdao Hospital and Shenzhen University Campus. Reference denotes renders of the source scenes.
blocks.zh: 图3:城市一级的质量比较。 上二行:CS-Air;下二行:青岛医院和深圳大学校园. 参考指源场景。

blocks.en: We compare CityCode with MajutsuCity and UrbanWorld2.0 on 547 building instances. CityCode leads all appearance metrics, improving PSNR by 3.47 and 3.67 dB and reducing foreground RGB MAE by 39.8% and 36.1%, respectively. These gains are consistent with our completion strategy, which combines observed source and roof appearance with recovered geometry to guide building proportions. Its 2.5D prism IoU is 0.737, slightly below MajutsuCity’s 0.746 but above UrbanWorld2.0’s 0.394 (Appendix ).
blocks.zh: 在547个建筑案例中,我们比较了城市代码和MajutsuCity和UrbanWorld2.0。 CityCode领导所有外观度量衡,将PSNR改进3.47和3.67 dB,并将前缘RGB MAE分别减少39.8%和36.1%. 这些进展符合我们的完成工作战略,该战略将观测到的源头和屋顶外观与恢复的几何学结合起来,以指导建筑比例。 它的2.5D棱镜IoU是0.737,略低于MajutsuCity的0.746,但高于UrbanWorld2.0的0.394(附录)。

blocks.en: 4.3 Metric Depth and City Geometry
blocks.zh: 4.3 测量深度和城市几何

blocks.en: Since Sat3DGen ( Qian et al., 2026b ) and Sat2Density++ ( Qian et al., 2026a ) lack instance building dimensions, Table 2 compares their mesh surfaces with CityCode’s depth-derived surface before proxy construction. CityCode leads all four DSM metrics on both datasets. Relative to the strongest baseline, RMSE decreases from 33.99 to 14.37 m on CS-Aerial and from 19.88 to 12.87 m on UrbanScene3D, without real-scene fine-tuning. We calibrate the adapted depths before backprojection using road and hardscape anchors, camera geometry, and local ground elevations. Without depth-scale calibration, CityCode still achieves lower DSM RMSE than both baselines on CS-Aerial (Appendix ).
blocks.zh: 由于Sat3DGen(Qian等人,2026b)和Sat2Density++(Qian等人,2026a)缺乏实例建筑维度,表2在代理构造之前将其网格表面与CityCode的深度衍生表面进行比较. CityCode在两个数据集上领先全部四个DSM度量衡. 相对于最强基线,RMSE在CS-Air上从33.99米降至14.37米,在UrbanScene3D上从19.88米降至12.87米,未进行实景微调. 我们利用道路和硬景锚地、照相机几何和局部地面高地来校准经过调整的深度,然后进行反射。 不进行深度尺度校准,CityCode仍然比CS-Air上的两条基线(Appendix )实现较低的DSM RMSE.

blocks.en:

blocks.en: 4.4 Long-Horizon Urban Interaction
blocks.zh: 4.4 长视城市互动

blocks.en: Beyond the example in Figure 4 , we evaluate CityCode on 50 task chains of 50 steps each, spanning construction, editing, spatial queries, multimodal retrieval, planning, and historical restoration. Each chain maintains its own evolving scene state. CityCode completes all 50 chains, with all 2,500 steps passing their task checks. Protocols and artifact verification are detailed in Appendix .

blocks.en: We also test the same 50 task chains on the data structures produced by UrbanWorld2.0 and MajutsuCity. The diagnostics expose gaps in task-level execution: UrbanWorld2.0’s adapted edits show cross-object constraint violations, while MajutsuCity lacks required road-relation workflows. Source inspection further finds no integrated workflow for restoring task-indexed city states in either evaluated implementation.
blocks.zh: 我们还在UrbanWorld2.0和MajutsuCity生产的数据结构上测试同样的50个任务链。 这些诊断揭示了任务一级执行工作的差距: UrbanWorld2.0的改编显示交叉对象约束违规,而MajutsuCity则缺乏所需的道路关系工作流程. 来源检查还发现,在两个评估的执行中,都没有恢复有任务索引的城市州的综合工作流程。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced CityCode and Air2Code to build grounded urban worlds from sparse aerial observations. Persistent identities and versioned execution link instance geometry, topology, and assets. Experiments show substantially more accurate metric structure recovery and superior visual fidelity to target cities than evaluated baselines. Across 50 task chains of 50 steps, these persistent, agent-operable cities support long-horizon urban spatial intelligence.
blocks.zh: 我们引进了CityCode和Air2Code,以利用稀少的空中观测来建立被禁足的城市世界. 持续的身份和版本的执行链接实例几何、地形和资产。 实验显示,与评估的基线相比,对目标城市的计量结构恢复和较高的视觉可靠性要高得多。 跨越50步的50个任务链,这些持久、可使用代理人的城市支持长距离的城市空间情报。

blocks.en: AI Use Statement
blocks.zh: AI 使用语句

blocks.en: We used large language models to assist with language polishing, literature search and review, code debugging, and checking final results. We also used GPT-5.6-sol as an agent for long-horizon task execution.
blocks.zh: 我们使用大型语言模型来协助语言抛光,文献搜索和审查,代码调试,以及检查最终结果. 我们还使用GPT-5.6-sol作为长距离任务执行的代理人.

blocks.en:
We support reproducibility through detailed supplementary documentation and
selected core implementations. The appendix describes data preparation,
training, and structure recovery (Appendix );
generation and prompt templates (Appendices , , and ); and execution,
evaluation, and task verification (Appendices , , and ).
The accompanying code supplement provides core implementations, configurations,

chains with saved requests and tool responses.
The supplementary video illustrates city generation results
and long-horizon spatial interaction. The code supplement supports inspection
of the implementation; end-to-end execution additionally requires external
checkpoints, datasets, API services, and integration components.
We plan to make runnable code publicly available.
